help.public: 📖 How to use the bot This bot watches your clan wars and posts alerts in the group automatically. ⚔️ Wars /war — Current regular war (roster, attacks, defense) /cwl — Clan War League day status /clan — Clan profile (level, league, members, …) Group alerts: opponent found / battle start / 1 hour left / war end. 🔗 Clash accounts /link #TAG — Link your account (ownership verified) Example: /link #ABC123XYZ /unlink #TAG — Unlink one account /unlinkall — Unlink all your accounts (asks confirmation) /myaccounts — Show your linked accounts Linking lets the bot mention you when attacks are still missing. 📊 Reports & settings /report — This month’s clan performance /report 2026-11 — Report for a specific month /setting — Bot settings (language now; more options later) /help — Show this guide
